title: Stream invertebrate counts, 2023
description: Counts of bottom-dwelling invertebrates, by family, from kick-net samples at two invented stream riffles in May and August 2023. Every site and count is invented; a sample package for the research archive.

archive:spatialCoverage.description: Two invented riffles on one invented brook.

archive:methods: A 0.25 square metre patch of bed was disturbed for one minute in front of a 500 micrometre kick net; animals were picked in the field and identified to family.
